purpose: Prevent public writes while Production moves from the 0020 application/schema boundary to the 0063 candidate boundary.
invariants: No public request may reach the old Production application after the Production database migration begins.
The candidate Production-target deployment must exist without receiving Production-domain traffic before the database migration starts.
The old Production deployment must remain available as a traffic target until cutover verification completes.
No application-only rollback to the old Production deployment is allowed after the database reaches 0063 or later.
Public traffic reopens only after candidate readiness, owner-state preservation, schema verification, and runtime smoke checks pass.
required_preconditions: phase10_preflight_v1 reports all hard gates resolved except the final explicit authorization action
exact candidate is green and zero commits behind main
Production backup/protection control is approved and current recovery evidence is fresh
one traffic barrier below is explicitly selected, available on the current Vercel plan, and tested
operator has credentials for Vercel, GitHub, and Neon/Alembic actions without placing credentials in logs or source

acceptable_methods.description: Temporarily require Vercel Authentication for all deployments/Production traffic, with an authorized automation/operator bypass retained for health checks.
proof_required: control is available on the connected PartGraph Vercel plan
unauthenticated Production request is blocked before migration
authorized operator health request still works
the exact method to disable protection after cutover is recorded

acceptable_methods.description: Point Production traffic to a separately verified maintenance deployment that cannot write to PartGraph data while the real candidate remains unaliased.
proof_required: maintenance deployment has no database mutation path
Production domain resolves only to maintenance response before migration
candidate deployment remains separate until post-migration verification
rollback can return traffic to the old Production deployment after database restore

rejected_shortcuts: Do not rely only on an environment variable that is absent from the currently deployed old application.
Do not revoke ad-hoc PostgreSQL privileges and attempt to reconstruct them during the cutover.
Do not use the old application against schema 0063 merely because health/read-only probes pass.
Do not merge PR #84 first and allow normal Vercel Git deployment to decide the ordering.

requirements: checkout/build is the exact approved candidate commit
deployment ID and commit metadata are recorded
no Production domain/traffic is assigned yet
deployment is not treated as healthy against Production until the database has been migrated

ordered_steps.action: Create the exact candidate as a Production-target Vercel deployment with domain assignment skipped.
ordered_steps.failure_action: Delete nothing; old Production continues normally.

ordered_steps.action: Activate and verify the approved traffic barrier. Stop all public PartGraph traffic/writes before touching the database.
ordered_steps.failure_action: Remove the unproven barrier and stop; do not migrate.

ordered_steps.action: Capture/verify the approved immediate pre-migration recovery point and record the Production branch/revision.
ordered_steps.failure_action: Stop and reopen old Production only after confirming no database change occurred.

ordered_steps.action: Run the rehearsed Alembic upgrade from 0020 to the exact repository head against Production.
ordered_steps.failure_action: Keep traffic blocked. Diagnose transactional state; use the approved recovery path rather than an automatic downgrade.

ordered_steps.action: Verify Alembic head, baseline owner/private preservation, schema contracts, and required post-migration database checks.
ordered_steps.failure_action: Keep traffic blocked and restore the approved pre-migration database state if forward correction is not proven safe.

ordered_steps.action: Run authorized readiness and read-only smoke checks directly against the unaliased Production-target candidate deployment.
ordered_steps.failure_action: Do not promote candidate. Restore database before returning to the old application unless a reviewed forward fix is used.

ordered_steps.action: Point Production traffic to the already-built verified candidate deployment while the traffic barrier is still active.
ordered_steps.failure_action: Keep barrier active and execute the coordinated rollback/forward-fix decision.

ordered_steps.action: Through the authorized barrier bypass, verify Production live/ready endpoints, critical read-only smoke paths, deployment identity, database revision, and clean runtime errors.
ordered_steps.failure_action: Keep barrier active and execute the coordinated rollback/forward-fix decision.

ordered_steps.action: Disable the traffic barrier only after all verification passes, then confirm public readiness and watch runtime errors.
ordered_steps.failure_action: Prefer forward correction. Any database restore must be coordinated with application traffic because post-open writes may exist.

ordered_steps.action: Complete PR/main reconciliation without allowing an unverified artifact to replace the verified Production deployment; record any subsequent Vercel deployment identity.
ordered_steps.failure_action: Do not change the Production alias until the replacement artifact is proven equivalent.

proof_to_retain: traffic barrier type and activation/deactivation evidence
candidate direct readiness and smoke result
rollback/forward-fix decision if any step deviated
